==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
"Alone I grabbed on to giant jellyfish and giant eels.
They shocked me and the electrical surge felt real.
It helped to ground the dream as an actual place with actual consequences.
The two giant sea creatures kept shocking me, trying to push me so far beyond normal limits that the dream world became truly real.
They spoke with me telepathically, urging me to fully accept the world around me.
When they finished shocking me, I had become someone else entirely.
I had long spiky glowing blonde hair, my clothes were tattered, my skin was covered in green and blue glyphs, my eyes were green, and I was in an absolutely beautiful void in space surrounded by glowing colorful coral.
This is the second dream in a row, where I've become someone else.
After that I had several false awakenings, and ended up going on a number of different adventures.
This is the second dream in a row, where I've had several false awakenings and lost my lucidity.
But I did have moments where my lucidity would return to me, so I wasn't completely lost.
This dream was mystically fulfilling in a very immersive way."
